properties.description:
Monitors data ingestion for medium-priority tables.
Query to display recent events:

let _step = 1h;
let lookback = 50h;
union isfuzzy=true
Cisco_Umbrella_dns_CL,
Cisco_Umbrella_proxy_CL,
Cisco_Umbrella_ip_CL,
Cisco_Umbrella_cloudfirewall_CL,
McasShadowItReporting,
ThreatIntelIndicators,
EmailEvents,
EmailUrlInfo,
IdentityLogonEvents,
IdentityQueryEvents,
IdentityDirectoryEvents,
CloudAppEvents,
AADServicePrincipalSignInLogs,
ADFSSignInLogs,
AADUserRiskEvents,
NetworkAccessTraffic,
AADRiskyServicePrincipals,
AADServicePrincipalRiskEvents,
MicrosoftGraphActivityLogs,
EnrichedOffice365AuditLogs,
RemoteNetworkHealthLogs
| make-series count() default=0 on TimeGenerated from bin(ago(lookback),_step) to bin(now(),_step) step _step by Type
| render timechart
properties.query:
// Service Ticket #4067293 - Tables stopped logging
// MEDIUM: compare the latest 2 hours with the previous baseline of 2days
let slot_duration = 1h;
let check_slots = 2;
let full_slots = 48 + check_slots;
let baseline_slots = full_slots - check_slots;
let enough_slots = toint(baseline_slots/2); // At least 50% slots are needed to calculate the baseline
// raise an alert if the average of the latest slots is smaller by 70% (1-0.3) of the MINIMUM value from the baseline
let threshold_percentage = 0.3;
/////////////////////////////////////////////////////
let currenttime = now(); // - 1h; //datetime(2025-03-18T13:00:00Z); // useful for debugging
let full_time = full_slots * slot_duration;
let check_time = check_slots * slot_duration;
let full_start = bin(currenttime - full_time, slot_duration); // Round the start time to the nearest full slot time
let full_now = bin(currenttime, slot_duration); // Round the end time to the nearest full slot time
let AnalysedTables =  (datatable(Type:string) [
    "Cisco_Umbrella_dns_CL",
    "Cisco_Umbrella_proxy_CL",
    "Cisco_Umbrella_ip_CL",
    "Cisco_Umbrella_cloudfirewall_CL",
    "McasShadowItReporting",
    "ThreatIntelligenceIndicator",
    "EmailEvents",
    "EmailUrlInfo",
    "IdentityLogonEvents",
    "IdentityQueryEvents",
    "IdentityDirectoryEvents",
    "CloudAppEvents",
    "AADServicePrincipalSignInLogs",
    "ADFSSignInLogs",
    "AADUserRiskEvents",
    "NetworkAccessTraffic",
    "AADRiskyServicePrincipals",
    "AADServicePrincipalRiskEvents",
    "MicrosoftGraphActivityLogs",
    "EnrichedOffice365AuditLogs",
    "RemoteNetworkHealthLogs"
]);
let t_slot_counts = union isfuzzy=true
    (Cisco_Umbrella_dns_CL           | where TimeGenerated between (full_start .. full_now) | summarize count_slot = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, slot_duration), Type),
    (Cisco_Umbrella_proxy_CL         | where TimeGenerated between (full_start .. full_now) | summarize count_slot = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, slot_duration), Type),
    (Cisco_Umbrella_ip_CL            | where TimeGenerated between (full_start .. full_now) | summarize count_slot = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, slot_duration), Type),
    (Cisco_Umbrella_cloudfirewall_CL | where TimeGenerated between (full_start .. full_now) | summarize count_slot = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, slot_duration), Type),
    (McasShadowItReporting           | where TimeGenerated between (full_start .. full_now) | summarize count_slot = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, slot_duration), Type),
    (ThreatIntelligenceIndicator     | where TimeGenerated between (full_start .. full_now) | summarize count_slot = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, slot_duration), Type),
    (EmailEvents                     | where TimeGenerated between (full_start .. full_now) | summarize count_slot = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, slot_duration), Type),
    (EmailUrlInfo                    | where TimeGenerated between (full_start .. full_now) | summarize count_slot = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, slot_duration), Type),
    (IdentityLogonEvents             | where TimeGenerated between (full_start .. full_now) | summarize count_slot = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, slot_duration), Type),
    (IdentityQueryEvents             | where TimeGenerated between (full_start .. full_now) | summarize count_slot = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, slot_duration), Type),
    (IdentityDirectoryEvents         | where TimeGenerated between (full_start .. full_now) | summarize count_slot = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, slot_duration), Type),
    (CloudAppEvents                  | where TimeGenerated between (full_start .. full_now) | summarize count_slot = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, slot_duration), Type),
    (AADServicePrincipalSignInLogs   | where TimeGenerated between (full_start .. full_now) | summarize count_slot = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, slot_duration), Type),
    (ADFSSignInLogs                  | where TimeGenerated between (full_start .. full_now) | summarize count_slot = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, slot_duration), Type),
    (AADUserRiskEvents               | where TimeGenerated between (full_start .. full_now) | summarize count_slot = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, slot_duration), Type),
    (NetworkAccessTraffic            | where TimeGenerated between (full_start .. full_now) | summarize count_slot = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, slot_duration), Type),
    (AADRiskyServicePrincipals       | where TimeGenerated between (full_start .. full_now) | summarize count_slot = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, slot_duration), Type),
    (AADServicePrincipalRiskEvents   | where TimeGenerated between (full_start .. full_now) | summarize count_slot = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, slot_duration), Type),
    (MicrosoftGraphActivityLogs      | where TimeGenerated between (full_start .. full_now) | summarize count_slot = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, slot_duration), Type),
    (EnrichedOffice365AuditLogs      | where TimeGenerated between (full_start .. full_now) | summarize count_slot = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, slot_duration), Type),
    (RemoteNetworkHealthLogs         | where TimeGenerated between (full_start .. full_now) | summarize count_slot = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, slot_duration), Type),
    (datatable()[]);
let t_baseline_raw = t_slot_counts | where TimeGenerated between (full_start .. (full_now - check_time -1ms)); // baseline considers all the slots excluding the ones in the check_time time window
let t_baseline_filter_enough_slots = (t_baseline_raw | summarize slots = count() by Type)
| join t_baseline_raw on Type
| where slots > enough_slots; // Ignore if we do not have enough data points
let t_baseline = t_baseline_filter_enough_slots
| summarize count_baseline = min(count_slot) by Type; // and then takes the slot with the LOWEST value
let t_check = t_slot_counts
| where TimeGenerated >= full_now - check_time  // Slots to check: considers all the slots in the check_time time window
| summarize count_check = toint(avg(count_slot)) by Type; // and then takes the average of these slots
// Now join with the static AnalysedTables to ensure that even tables with completely missing entries are reported
let t_output = AnalysedTables
| join kind=fullouter (t_baseline) on Type
| join kind=fullouter (t_check) on Type
| extend count_baseline = coalesce(count_baseline, 0), count_check = coalesce(count_check, 0)
//| order by case(count_baseline == 0, 1, 0) asc, Type asc // this is just for easier debugging
// Alert if the current average is lower than X% of the lowest baseline slot
| where count_baseline > 0 and count_check < max_of(1,round(threshold_percentage * count_baseline,0));
// Add a column with the list of affected tables per customer
let t_affectedtables = t_output | summarize AffectedTables=array_strcat(todynamic(make_set(Type,100)),",");
t_output | extend OtherAffectedTables = toscalar(t_affectedtables)
| project Table=Type, count_baseline, count_check, OtherAffectedTables, TimeSlot = full_now
